posts.title: Extend the Life of High-Voltage Equipment with Maintenance and Repairs | Ampcontrol posted on the topic
posts.copy: Ageing high-voltage equipment doesn't automatically need replacing. A transformer that's been in service for thirty years might need a rewind, a tap changer overhaul, or nothing more than a maintenance visit. Our HV field service teams do all of that work, from engineering and compliance through testing, commissioning, maintenance, overhauls and refurbishment. By supporting them throughout their lifecycle, your assets stay in service longer, and you can save replacement budget for the assets that genuinely need it. Swipe through for the full picture 👉 Find out more 👉 https://lnkd.in/dWe_gNpp

posts.title: Tomago Transformer Facility Final Testing | Ampcontrol posted on the topic
posts.copy: A rare look inside our Tomago transformer facility as a 50MVA transformer is prepared for final high-voltage testing. This critical milestone represents one of the final stages in the manufacture or overhaul of a transformer, where performance, reliability, and safety are verified before the unit is released for transport to the customer's site. Beyond our workshop capabilities, Ampcontrol can perform these high-voltage transformer testing in the field using our mobile HV testing truck.
